card.name: Inside chemical names with locants
card.fires_on: Numbers, commas, primes and short pieces inside systematic chemical names, such as locants like 1, 3 or N,N and syllables like oxo or olo. It responds partway through the name, before it is finished.

modes.label: Locant numbers and commas
modes.description: Position numbers or commas inside a chemical name's locant string.

modes.label: N,N prefixes
modes.description: The second N after a comma in N,N-dialkyl amide names.

modes.label: Name syllables
modes.description: Middle syllables of long chemical names.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long chemical names, on the numbers and small pieces that locate parts of the molecule.
